trace.detail:
MESSAGE:
Dear Acme Cloud Services Team,

Thank you for your email regarding renewal of our contract, currently set to end on 31 October 2026. We value our partnership and are open to renewing for a further 12-month term under Clause 8.1.

However, the proposed 12% increase exceeds the maximum renewal cap of 7% permitted under Clause 8.2 of our agreement, unless both parties agree otherwise in writing. We are not in a position to accept an increase of this magnitude at this time.

Separately, we note that service levels fell below the 99.9% monthly uptime target specified in Clause 4.1 during May 2026 (99.42%) and July 2026 (99.61%). Under Clause 4.2, this entitles us to service credits of Rs 10,000 for each affected month, totaling Rs 20,000, which have not yet been credited to our account. Please apply these credits before renewal proceeds.

Given the above, and current market alternatives, we propose a renewal at a maximum increase within the 7% cap over our current annual fee of Rs 24,00,000, alongside issuance of the Rs 20,000 in outstanding service credits. Should you wish to propose an increase between 5-10%, please provide supporting justification for our review.

We look forward to your revised proposal and confirmation of the service credits at your earliest convenience.

Best regards,
Nimbus Retail Procurement

INTERNAL NOTE:
12% exceeds 7% cap (Clause 8.2) — must negotiate down per Policy Rule 3. Any 5-10% counter needs Finance Director approval with justification
